title: Equal Groups Division Word Problems
intro: Help your student distinguish equal sharing from finding the number of groups.
html:
Teaching notes for parents and teachers

How to teach it

Use the same total in two models: a stated number of groups, and a stated amount in each group. Label the unknown in each.

Ask your student

What does the answer count in this story?

If your student needs help

If the models are confused, give the student counters and have them carry out each grouping action.
